before.requirement: For a supported gzip-wrapped deflate stream, make caller-supplied header fields installed through deflateSetHeader reachable and emit them.
before.reason: Window bits can select gzip wrapping only under GZIP. If enabled, the fixed deflateInit call selects the default wrapper and the harness has no header-installation route.

after.requirement: For a supported gzip-wrapped deflate stream, make caller-supplied header fields installed through deflateSetHeader reachable and emit them.
after.reason: The header installation and emission contracts remain available under GZIP. The same fixed harness still uses the default initializer and supplies no header; effective GZIP support remains unresolved.

claims.reason: Conditional on GZIP being enabled, the same default-wrapper initialization and absence of deflateSetHeader block this identical behavior before and after. The effective build setting prevents a definite applicability or maintenance finding.
missing_information: The guard defining GZIP in deflate.h and the effective compile definitions for deflate.c under the supplied configure and make defaults.
The effective GZIP definition when deflate.c is compiled by the supplied configure and make recipe.
